summary.intent: Use the GSD manager workflow to drive CipherBox milestone v2.0 to completion: verify/fix stuck phases (69, 70.1), plan and execute closeout phases (74, 75, 77) autonomously across quota interruptions, and ship completed phases through the full ship-phase pipeline (verify/secure/validate/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit/PR).
summary.outcome: Phases 69, 70.1, 74, 75, and 77 were completed and phase 74 was merged via PR #607 after a deep investigation uncovered and fixed a real macOS-only FUSE-T rotation race (stale metadata refresh clobbering rotated keys) plus an access-token-TTL bug it exposed; phase 75 ship-phase was underway (with a stranded-todo bookkeeping fix) when the transcript ends; phases 76/78/79 remain unplanned.

repo: GSD's plan-file scanner (plan-scan.cjs) uses a loose case-insensitive substring match for 'PLAN' as a fallback after the `*-PLAN.md` pattern — any doc like `69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md` gets miscounted as a plan, desyncing plan/summary parity and showing a complete phase as 'Executing'.

Sub-agents launched at the repo root cannot use EnterWorktree to pin into a pre-existing worktree ('repo root, not an isolated worktree') — the working pattern for resuming worktree-planned work is sequential main-checkout-on-feat-branch processing, not worktree re-entry.

CipherBox has two type-identical but incompatible encoding domains for encrypted key material: internal node-codec fields (readKeySealed, read_sealed) are base64; all 4 share-API wire DTOs (create-share, create-invite, claim-invite, update-grant) validate encryptedReadKey/encryptedWriteKey/itemNameEncrypted as hex via `@Matches(/^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/)`. Nothing at the type level forces the right choice, and unit tests mock the boundary so mismatches only surface in e2e — this bug has recurred multiple times.

write_sealed AAD binds node.generation() (crates/core/src/node/seal.rs:188-192) — after a rotation bumps generation, any preserved write body must be re-sealed at the new generation with the (stable) write key, not carried forward unchanged.

macOS FUSE-T/SMB's overwrite-rename issues an `open()` on the SOURCE file before renaming; Linux's kernel rename never opens either file. This is why rotation-adjacent races are consistently macOS-only and pass on Linux/Windows with identical code.

FUSE's `drain_refresh_completions` already guards against stale background-refresh clobbering: if a folder ino is in `mutated_folders` or `publish_queue`, it calls `mark_remotely_edited_files_unresolved` (preserves keys) instead of `apply_owned_children` (resets keys, incl. resetting File cid to empty). Any code path that republishes folders out-of-band (like scope-exit rotation) must mark them in `mutated_folders` or this guard never fires for it.

Access-token TTL is hardcoded to 15m in apps/api/src/auth/services/token.service.ts; headless test-login sessions (like desktop-e2e) authenticate once at startup with no refresh path, so any single test run exceeding ~15 min real time will 401-lock mid-suite.

vitest does not load .env files — SDK_E2E_SECRET (and similar) must be explicitly exported into the shell before running sdk-e2e, or the harness silently falls back to a default secret that the API rejects with 401.

A running API on :3000 is often a stale `node dist/main.js` process from a prior session serving old compiled code with mismatched env secrets — always verify/restart from source before trusting test results against it.

Building the desktop binary on macOS can accidentally link macFUSE instead of FUSE-T if the system's `fuse.pc` pkg-config file is macFUSE's; CI copies fuse-t.pc over it, but locally this requires a non-destructive PKG_CONFIG_PATH override with a FUSE-T-aliased fuse.pc placed first.
The gsd commit helper occasionally reports `commit_failed` while the commit actually landed — must verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blindly retry (retrying risks duplicate/empty commits).

code.finding: Fix: after a scope-exit rotation refreshes inode keys, mark the rotated folders as `mutated_folders` (with current Instant) so the existing stale-refresh guard in drain_refresh_completions protects them; this closed the macOS-only Part D rename race.
drain_refresh_completions checks mutated_folders/publish_queue membership to decide between key-preserving mark_remotely_edited_files_unresolved and key-resetting apply_owned_children.
write_sealed's AAD binds node.generation(), so any code path reusing/preserving a write body across a rotation must re-seal at the new generation.
Access token TTL hardcoded to 15m; made configurable via ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL env var (default unchanged) to fix long-running desktop-e2e macOS runs 401-locking.

Rotation republish deliberately sets write_sealed: None (deferred to a Phase-72 follow-up per code comment) — a real latent durability bug (owned-walks fail, replay can't recover signing seed) filed as a separate todo rather than fixed inline, to keep the shipped fix minimal.
Grant re-mint's encryptedReadKey was base64-encoded but the share API validates it as hex — SC#2 runtime 400 bug, fixed to hex-encode; internal node-codec fields correctly remain base64.
Loose /PLAN/i substring fallback in the plan-file matcher causes false-positive plan counts from non-plan docs whose filename merely contains 'PLAN' (e.g. a file with 'PLANE' in the name).

workflow: When a background agent is quota-interrupted mid-task, assess actual on-disk state (git log, ls plan files, worktree list) before trusting the agent's last streamed message — agents can be further along than their final printed status implies, or have uncommitted work that needs preserving before relaunch.

For consistent-but-unexplained platform-specific CI failures, reproduce locally on the failing platform rather than accepting the first plausible-sounding explanation (401 in logs) — the user's insistence on local reproduction surfaced the real root cause after several dead-end hypotheses.

When debugging a subtle race/atomicity bug, instrument with targeted debug logging (key fingerprints, decision points) rather than reasoning abstractly — direct evidence collapsed several plausible-but-wrong hypotheses (API resolve lag, stale captured key, wrong file being rotated) before finding the true cause.

Before applying a fix for a recurring class of bug (hex/base64), verify the fix at the specific site works, then separately consider whether the systemic pattern deserves a dedicated hardening effort — captured as a todo rather than expanding scope of the immediate fix.

Autonomous quota-survival pattern: schedule a CronCreate resume with the CURRENT correct method and state (not the original plan) each time the approach changes, and cancel/replace it as soon as the recovery method is proven, to avoid a stale cron re-triggering a known-bad approach.

Confirm-before-code discipline paid off: when asked to verify the API resolve-consistency hypothesis before touching crypto/resolve code, the confirmation refuted the hypothesis, avoiding an incorrect fix to a sensitive resolve path.

friction: Session repeatedly hit Claude usage/session limits mid-task (quota resets at 4:40am, 9:40am, etc.), interrupting background planner/executor agents and requiring cron-based autonomous resume scaffolding.

Sub-agent EnterWorktree into pre-existing worktrees consistently failed ('repo root, not an isolated worktree'), wasting two agent dispatches before pivoting to sequential main-checkout-on-feat-branch.
Initial misdiagnosis of the macOS desktop-e2e failure as a '401 infra flake' was incorrect and required user correction with the real log before proper diagnosis began.

Multiple plausible-but-wrong fixes attempted before the real root cause: write_sealed preservation (real bug but not the cause), FilePointer read-path self-heal (insufficient — published data itself was inconsistent), coalesced dest-gate exclusion (fixed the wrong file — destination, not source).
Stale mount / leftover go-nfsv4 process caused 'FUSE filesystem unmounted immediately' errors requiring manual cleanup between local reproduction attempts.

Each local reproduction cycle (docker stack reset, DB recreate, migrations, API restart, desktop binary rebuild, mount, run test) took ~10 minutes, and was repeated ~10 times during the investigation.

GSD scanner's loose plan-file substring match caused a false 'Executing' status on a fully complete phase (69), requiring investigation that initially went down a wrong path (writing a UAT stub) before the real cause (filename collision) was found.
STATE.md merge conflicts during rebase of the phase-75 branch onto the newly-updated main (both branches had evolved planning bookkeeping).
open_items: Hex/base64 wire-encoding domain hardening (high-severity todo): authoritative encoding-contract doc, named boundary codecs, branded string types for compile-time enforcement, and a client-vs-DTO contract test — deferred as its own future hardening phase.
write_sealed:None durability bug in rotation republish — owned-walks fail and replay can't recover the signing seed; prototyped fix reverted to keep the shipped fix minimal, filed as pending todo.
ts-rotatednodes-defensive-copy-parity todo: TS rotated-key map stores references (not clones) aliased with parentNewReadKey, a latent zeroization hazard if a future change zeros that buffer.
remint-trusts-server-recipient-pubkey-binding (MEDIUM security): re-mint trusts the server for recipient pubkey binding, newly reachable on desktop — deferred as todo.
desktop-rust-client-no-token-refresh-on-401 todo: the Rust background client has no auto-refresh-on-401, so a real long-running desktop session could 401-lock (webview mitigates in production).
Phases 76, 78, and 79 remain unplanned — deliberately paused/deferred pending user direction.

macOS FUSE-T/SMB cache-invalidation limitation (behind the pre-existing #560 stopgap) still gates cross-platform tests 5 & 7 as macOS-optional; confirmed unrelated to and unfixed by the Part D rotation fix.

Phase 75 ship-phase pipeline was in progress (rebased onto post-#607 main, Rust/crypto audit agents dispatched, stranded phase-74 todos discovered and moved to completed/) when the transcript ends — SDK-E2E gate, CodeRabbit, and PR creation for phase 75 not yet reached.
